# HudFabric 1.0.9 — release notes

HudFabric 1.0.9 fixes effects HUD crashes caused by invalid characters in modded status-effect icon paths. The invalid icon is skipped while the effect name and duration remain visible. The fix is included in all nine builds for Minecraft 1.21–1.21.11 and 26.1–26.3.

## Release links

[Source code](https://github.com/abcnova/HudFabric) · [GitHub release 1.0.9](https://github.com/abcnova/HudFabric/releases/tag/v1.0.9) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/abcnova/HudFabric/issues)

## Build files

| File | Minecraft versions |
| --- | --- |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-1.21-1.21.1.jar | 1.21–1.21.1 |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-2-1.21.2-1.21.5.jar | 1.21.2–1.21.5 |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-3-1.21.6-1.21.7.jar | 1.21.6–1.21.7 |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-4-1.21.8.jar | 1.21.8 |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-5-1.21.9-1.21.10.jar | 1.21.9–1.21.10 |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-6-1.21.11.jar | 1.21.11 |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-7-26.1-26.1.2.jar | 26.1–26.1.2 |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-8-26.2.jar | 26.2 |
| HudFabric-1.0.9-9-26.3.jar | 26.3 |

Each artifact retains its existing Minecraft, Fabric Loader, Fabric API, and Java target settings. Mod Menu remains optional.

HudFabric is licensed under the MIT License. Fabric Loader and Fabric API are required. Java 21 is required for Minecraft 1.21.x; Java 25 is required for Minecraft 26.x. Mod Menu is optional.

releases.notes:
# HudFabric 1.0.8

HudFabric 1.0.8 adds privacy-safe settings codes for sharing via Discord, a movable pause-menu HUD Editor button, and vanilla resource-pack hotbar textures for independent armor slots. It also includes the editable note board, totem and active-arrow counter, optional armor-break warning (off by default), reset controls, and grouped compatibility JARs from Minecraft 1.21 through 26.3.

### Follow-up fixes in the refreshed 1.0.8 release

- Fixed HUD module movement on Minecraft 26.3: the editor now checks SDL3's left mouse-button constant rather than the old GLFW value `0`.
- Updated the 26.3 client regression test to use that same native button constant. It moves the stats module from `(20, 60)` to `(65, 90)` and verifies the saved position.
- Updated the pause-menu HUD Editor button's repositioning check to use the version-correct left-button constant as well.
- Redesigned the personal note board for all supported versions as a blocky wooden board with a cork-like surface, pinned paper, ruled writing lines, and a matching editor.
- The note board remains local to each client; it is not synchronized to other players or a server.

Settings codes omit server-specific profiles and addresses; importing a code preserves the recipient's local server profiles.

All nine grouped compatibility projects passed Gradle `build` on 2026-10-25. The automated Minecraft 26.3 client drag test passed and confirmed the updated saved coordinates. The release contains nine JARs for Minecraft 1.21 through 26.3.

Nine JARs and `SHA256SUMS.txt` are attached. Match the artifact filename to your Minecraft version. Fabric Loader and Fabric API are required; Java 25 is required for Minecraft 26.x. Mod Menu is optional.

releases.notes:
# HudFabric 1.0.7

This update repairs the HUD editor and makes settings easier to manage across the supported Minecraft versions.

- Open the HUD canvas directly from Mod Menu, the pause menu, or the keybind.
- Fix module dragging that failed in 1.0.6 on Minecraft 26.3 by tracking held mouse movement; verified with a 26.3 client game test.
- Keep saved HUD elements and separate armor slots inside the visible canvas when the window size changes.
- Show the installed HudFabric version and project icon in the settings header.
- Keep the familiar 1.0.6 settings layout. All eight modules fit without scrolling at the tested compact window size; scrolling appears when the available height is smaller. Long labels stay inside their buttons, and narrow screens use a separate color page.
- Show the full Jump Reset Indicator heading above its clearly separated Background and Text color controls.
- Reset one module, the crosshair, or extra settings to their first-install defaults; reset everything from the module overview. Changes are saved to the active server profile.
- Remove unsupported server glyphs and trailing symbols from custom scoreboard titles while keeping styled text.
- Preserve potion effects when entering a world.

Dedicated JARs target Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, and 26.3. Existing settings are retained unless a reset button is used.

# HudFabric 1.0.6

This compatibility and reliability update adds Minecraft 26.3 and makes the
Jump Reset Indicator much more precise.

## Highlights

- Minecraft 26.3 support
- Six dedicated builds from 1.21.11 through 26.3
- Real jump-event detection instead of key polling
- Combat-only Jump Reset Indicator activation
- Early, perfect, late, and missed timing feedback
- Updated translations and consistent module naming
- Dependency and performance cleanup across all supported versions

Existing HudFabric settings remain compatible and are migrated automatically.

## HudFabric 1.0.5

- Accurate left/right CPS tracking, including fast clicking and autoclickers
- Jump Reset feedback now triggers only during real player combat and ignores normal jumping or unrelated damage
- Two armor durability styles: panel and clean vanilla hotbar slots
- Individually movable armor slots, improved offhand spacing and reliable offhand rendering
- Crosshair Indicator integration and refined crosshair designs
- Reworked module settings, per-module colors, draggable scrollbars and HUD editor controls
- Improved effect timers, server transitions, large scoreboards and long-duration formatting
- Safe configuration migration preserves existing 1.0.4 settings

Supports Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2.
